'Ser aburrido' means 'to be bored' and 'estar aburrido' means 'to be boring'
'Ser aburrido' is used for people and 'estar aburrido' is used for things
q_gram_c2_15_003.explanation: Der/die/das ser/estar distinction mit Adjektivs ist fundamental. Mit 'aburrido': ser beschreibt an inherent characteristic (Juan es aburrido = Juan ist a boring Person), während estar beschreibt a state oder condition (Juan está aburrido = Juan ist bored right now). Dies A2-level concept muss sein fully mastered von C2.

q_gram_c2_15_004.question: A no ser que se ___ medidas urgentes, la crisis se agravará irreversiblemente. (tomar, Präsens Konjunktiv)
q_gram_c2_15_004.explanation: 'A no ser que' (unless) immer triggers der/die/das Konjunktiv. Da der/die/das main Nebensatz uses der/die/das Zukunft ('se agravará'), der/die/das subordinate Nebensatz takes der/die/das Präsens Konjunktiv 'tomen'. Der/die/das impersonal 'se' mit Plural 'medidas' requires der/die/das Pluralform. Dies tests mastery across Konjunktiv triggers, Zeitform sequencing, und impersonal constructions.
q_gram_c2_15_004.conjugation_info: tomar (Präsens Konjunktiv): tome, tomes, tome, tomemos, toméis, tomen

q_gram_c2_15_005.question: El informe, ___ conclusiones fueron cuestionadas por varios expertos, ha sido revisado por completo.
q_gram_c2_15_005.explanation: 'Cuyas' ist der/die/das weiblich Plural relative possessive Pronomen, agreeing mit 'conclusiones' (weiblich Plural), not mit 'el informe' (männlich). 'Cuyo/a/os/as' stimmt überein mit der/die/das thing possessed, not der/die/das possessor. 'Que sus' ist ungrammatical in standard Spanisch relative Nebensatzs.
q_gram_c2_15_005.hint: Der/die/das relative possessive muss agree in gender und number mit der/die/das possessed Nomen

q_gram_c2_15_006.question: De haberlo ___ antes, habríamos tomado otra decisión. (saber, Vergangenheit Partizip — mixed Konditional mit compound Infinitiv)
q_gram_c2_15_006.explanation: 'De haberlo sabido' (hatte we known es) ist a compressed Konditional structure equivalent zu 'Si lo hubiéramos sabido'. Der/die/das compound Infinitiv 'haber + Vergangenheit Partizip' replaces der/die/das full si-Nebensatz. Das ist ein C1-C2 construction das combines knowledge von Konditionals, Infinitiv Nebensatzs, und clitic placement.
q_gram_c2_15_006.conjugation_info: saber (Vergangenheit participle): sabido; compound infinitive: haber sabido

q_gram_c2_15_007.question: Sea ___ sea el resultado, aceptaremos la decisión del tribunal.
q_gram_c2_15_007.explanation: 'Sea cual sea' (whatever/whichever... may sein) ist a fixed concessive construction using der/die/das duplicated Präsens Konjunktiv von 'ser'. Der/die/das interrogative Pronomen 'cual' ist der/die/das nur richtig option in dies structure. Dies formula wird verwendet across alle registers um auszudrücken indifference zu outcome.

q_gram_c2_15_008.question: Hatte es not been für dein help, we würde not haben succeeded.
q_gram_c2_15_008.correct: De no haber sido por tu ayuda, no habríamos tenido éxito.
wrong: Si no hubiera sido por tu ayuda, no tuviéramos éxito.
Si no fuera por tu ayuda, no habríamos tenido éxito.
De no ser por tu ayuda, no habríamos tenido éxito.
q_gram_c2_15_008.explanation: 'Hatte es not been für' requires der/die/das Vergangenheit counterfactual: 'De no haber sido por' (compound Infinitiv construction). 'De no ser por' würde bedeuten 'waren es not für' (Präsens counterfactual). Der/die/das main Nebensatz uses der/die/das Konditional perfect 'habríamos tenido éxito' (würde haben succeeded).

q_gram_c2_15_009.question: Por mucho que se lo ___ , nunca nos hizo caso. (repetir, Imperfekt Konjunktiv, nosotros-Form — concessive Nebensatz mit quantifier)
q_gram_c2_15_009.explanation: 'Por mucho que' (no matter wie much) triggers der/die/das Konjunktiv. Der/die/das Imperfekt Konjunktiv 'repitiéramos' ist erforderlich weil der/die/das main Nebensatz ist in der/die/das Präteritum ('hizo'). Note der/die/das Stamm change: repetir → repit- in der/die/das Konjunktiv (von der/die/das third Person Präteritum Stamm 'repitió'). Der/die/das clitic 'se lo' precedes der/die/das conjugated Verb.
q_gram_c2_15_009.conjugation_info: repetir (Imperfekt Konjunktiv): repitiera, repitieras, repitiera, repitiéramos, repitierais, repitieran

q_gram_c2_15_010.question: Dicho sea de paso, no es la primera vez que se incumple el protocolo establecido, lo cual pone en entredicho la credibilidad de la institución.
q_gram_c2_15_010.correct: Incidentally, it is not the first time that the established protocol has been breached, which calls into question the institution's credibility.
wrong: Said in passing, it is not the first time they don't comply with the established protocol, which puts in between-said the credibility of the institution.
By the way, it is not the first time that the established protocol is unfulfilled, the which puts into question the credibility of the institution.
That said in passing, this is not the first time the protocol was not complied with, which casts doubt on the institution's credibility.
q_gram_c2_15_010.explanation: 'Dicho sea de paso' ist a fixed parenthetical expression Bedeutung 'incidentally / von der/die/das way'. 'Se incumple' (impersonal se + Präsens) translates as 'hat been breached' zu capture der/die/das resultative Bedeutung. 'Poner en entredicho' ist an idiom Bedeutung 'zu call into question / zu undermine'. Dies Satz tests mastery von multiple advanced structures simultaneously.
